title: Form Input Bindings: v-model
description: Two-way data binding for form inputs – the heart of user input handling.

slides.title: What is v-model?
slides.content:
# Two-Way Binding `v-model` creates a **two-way data binding** between a form input and a piece of data. - When the user types, the data updates. - When the data changes programmatically, the input updates. ```html

You typed: {{ message }}

``` Under the hood, it's syntactic sugar for `:value` + `@input`.

slides.title: v-model Modifiers
slides.content:
**Modifiers** adjust the behavior of `v-model`:

- `.lazy` – sync after `change` event instead of `input`.
- `.number` – cast input to a number.
- `.trim` – trim whitespace.

```html
<input v-model.number="age">
<input v-model.trim="username">
```

quizData.question: What does `v-model` do?

options.text: It binds data one-way from component to view
It creates two-way binding between a form input and a data property
It is used for conditional rendering

quizData.explanation: `v-model` provides two-way binding: updates the data when the user inputs, and updates the input when data changes.
